timeline.body: Since this is a breaking change, we should add something to the release notes at the minimum, though maybe we don't change the name at all? People can have existing configuration that uses `watchos_arm64` to mean the simulator, and some rulesets would have to do a version check or something similar to get the right version of this: https://github.com/buildbuddy-io/rules_xcodeproj/blob/47d9510b64878ae1893d355cbf134d6a4b6eb715/xcodeproj/internal/xcodeproj_rule.bzl#L490-L493

reply.body:
> Since this is a breaking change, we should add something to the release notes at the minimum, though maybe we don't change the name at all?

I think breaking change would be suitable for 6.0.0 release? 👀 I wanted to be consistent with the other names, otherwise it can get confusing.
It's the best time to break it, yes, but I was also starting how it's tricky for rulesets to do things based on the bazel version.

timeline.body: This would also have to change in apple_support. Also a breaking change: https://github.com/bazelbuild/apple_support/blob/e81e1ea6d2a089337955c6a956dc3f96ed67ed09/platforms/BUILD#L129-L136

reply.body: Should I also make the change in `platforms/BUILD`?

timeline.body: don't see how we can avoid the breaking-ness of this without causing worse issues, so I think we should merge and add in the release notes
We should try to get this into Bazel 6.0. @sgowroji
Can we add this to the 6.0 milestone?

@meteorcloudy I'll add this to the list of issues for the 6.0 milestone to be _considered_ as a requirement for 6.0 . I personally don't think this should block 6.0 (it's been delayed enough), but it's useful to keep track of the "nice to haves" for that release.
Seems this was already addressed a different way upstream? https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/ce611646969cfe72ae5e22083708684eae11e478
Looks like the alternative change is already in 6.0.0, so I'll close this one
